{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend blazer, tailored fit, elbow length, deep forest green (#1A3C34), heavy woven wool.
Silk blouse, relaxed collar, hip length, ivory (#FFFFF0), smooth satin silk.
Wide-leg trousers, straight leg, ankle length, charcoal grey (#2F3336), structured crepe.
Stilettos, classic pump, mid-calf height, metallic gold (#D4AF37), polished leather.
Gold vermeil hoop earrings and a delicate pearl pendant necklace.

This ensemble balances the celebratory occasion with a sophisticated autumn palette, utilizing rich forest green and charcoal to complement her warm skin tones. The structured wool blazer and crepe trousers provide the necessary formality for a formal event while maintaining comfort in cooler weather. Delicate gold accents and a silk blouse add a touch of elegance without overwhelming the refined silhouette, perfectly aligning with her request for a formal look."}
